notes: Amounts belong to DPWH district offices, not to representatives; the documents do not say who asked for any project.
“Added” means no matching NEP project was found for a House bill project: a candidate, not a confirmed insertion.
House bill projects whose NEP match is unconfirmed (389, worth ₱10,517,119,000) are not counted as added.
Enacted budgets for 2020 to 2026 cover each office’s whole budget; the 2027 figures cover listed projects only.
